entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker, an outcast turned revolutionary who can petrify enemies with a glance and leads the Golgari guild.

entities.name: The Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A guild on Ravnica led by Vraska.

events.summary: Abuse and discrimination in her youth shape Vraska into a revolutionary dedicated to overthrowing unjust systems on Ravnica.
events.quote: The abuse and discrimination she faced in her youth shaped her into a revolutionary

relations.quote: she leads the Golgari guild toward a better future by whatever means necessary.
